## Goal

As a player, when an Orbital Strike lands I want to **hear** it — a signature impact cue of its own — so the strike is unmistakable even when I am not looking at the target.

## Parent

AH-0MVRE6N08001TE4V — Orbital Strike does nothing (AC2).

## Context

The strike path is completely silent today: `CombatScene.onOrbitalStrike` makes no `play*` call, `src/audio/effects.ts` exports no strike cue, and `audio/toneforge/manifest.json` (66 cues) has no strike entry. The unrelated Missile-Command hazard *is* audible because it borrows `playScoutAdvanceCue` (`docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md:94`) — which is exactly why the power-up reads as broken by comparison.

The producer confirmed a **new dedicated baked recipe** (Appendix Q2), so reusing an existing cue is out of scope.

## Deliverables

- New recipe `audio/toneforge/recipes/aihell-orbital-strike.yaml` — a descending-from-orbit impact: a falling filtered sweep into a low detonation thump plus a short bright crack; the recipe JSDoc/`meta.description` states the intended character and its seed.
- `audio/toneforge/manifest.json` entry: cue `playOrbitalStrikeSound`, `recipe: "aihell-orbital-strike"`, `delivery: "baked"`, seed drawn from the game-specific reservation (seed block 32100–32199 per `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md`), rendered through `scripts/build-audio.sh` with regenerated `public/audio/sfx/checksums.json`.
- New `playOrbitalStrikeSound()` export in `src/audio/effects.ts`, routed through the existing shared one-shot helper (no bespoke playback code).
- `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md` cue-table row for the new cue (source character, consumers, disposition `new-recipe`).
- Audition note recorded in the work-item comment: baked RMS/peak within the player-cue range, no clipping, and the cue is audibly distinct from `playNovaImpactSound` and `playMortarDetonationSound`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Dedicated audio cue.** A new `playOrbitalStrikeSound` cue exists in `src/audio/effects.ts` with a new `aihell-orbital-strike` ToneForge recipe.
- `npm run build-audio:verify` passes with the new asset (baked WAV present, checksum regenerated, no clipping, recipe parses).
- The recipe is tagged as a player/power-up cue, not an enemy-family cue, so the enemy balance guard's tier tables are unaffected and the new cue does not perturb `docs/AUDIO_ENEMY_BALANCE.md` numbers.
- The cue is audibly and structurally distinct from the existing AOE cues (`playNovaImpactSound`, `playMortarDetonationSound`): different recipe file, different seed, documented character.
- `/skill:test` (changed scope) passes.

## Constraints

- Audio must go through the cue pipeline: a `manifest.json` entry plus a recipe under `audio/toneforge/recipes/` plus a baked WAV rebuild. Never synthesise a cue ad hoc at runtime.
- No new runtime dependencies; no hand-edited `public/audio/sfx/checksums.json` (it is generated).
- Do not retune existing cues as part of this item.
- The sibling wiring item consumes this cue's export — do not call the cue from `src/scenes/core/CombatScene.ts` here (that wiring is AC1/AC5 work and keeps the diff reviewable).

## Parent AC traceability (this item's ACs above must satisfy these):
- Parent AC2: **Dedicated audio cue.** A new `playOrbitalStrikeSound` cue exists in `src/audio/effects.ts`, backed by a **new** ToneForge recipe (`aihell-orbital-strike`, baked WAV built via `scripts/build-audio.sh`), registered in `audio/toneforge/manifest.json`, and played by the shared strike path; `src/audio/effects.contract.test.ts` and `src/audio/cueManifest.test.ts` stay green.

**Key Files:**
- `audio/toneforge/recipes/aihell-orbital-strike.yaml`
- `audio/toneforge/manifest.json`
- `src/audio/effects.ts`
- `src/audio/cueManifest.test.ts`
- `src/audio/effects.contract.test.ts`
- `scripts/build-audio.sh`
- `docs/AUDIO_TONEFORGE_CUE_MAPPING.md`

## Goal

Bake the four new Mystery UFO cues through the existing ToneForge pipeline so the feel slices only call `src/audio/effects.ts` wrappers, and every cue is a safe no-op without an AudioContext.
